levels.title: Kana And First Symbols
levels.canDoSummary: Recognize hiragana, katakana, and a small set of common kanji symbols before A1 sentences.

levels.title: Survival Foundations
levels.canDoSummary: Identify people, things, and places; ask simple questions; describe static scenes; talk about simple past and time.

levels.title: Everyday Control
levels.canDoSummary: Describe routines, actions, places, time, preferences, wants, requests, permission, and simple sequences.

levels.title: Connected Japanese
levels.canDoSummary: Connect personal ideas, explain reasons, contrast, narrate, quote thoughts, describe abilities and obligations, and compare.

levels.title: Flexible Social Japanese
levels.canDoSummary: Handle nuance, conditions, indirectness, social direction, reported information, plans, passive and causative forms, and formal basics.
